subject: microbiology
title: Antigens, Haptens, Superantigens and Lymphocyte Populations

steps.tx: A **complete antigen** both provokes and reacts with immune products (immunogenicity plus reactivity), usually a foreign protein above 10 kilodaltons, while a **hapten** (penicillin metabolites, urushiol, nickel) reacts but cannot provoke until conjugated to a carrier protein, the Landsteiner principle behind contact dermatitis and drug allergy. Size, foreignness, degradability and host genetics grade immunogenicity.
steps.say: Haptens are half antigens until a carrier protein lends them a stage.

right.title: Hapten stories
points: Hapten carrier used deliberately in conjugate vaccines

steps.tx: **Superantigens** (staphylococcal TSST 1 and enterotoxins, streptococcal toxins) crosslink MHC class II to T cell receptor V beta regions outside the peptide groove, activating whole percent of T cells (versus 0.01 percent conventionally) into cytokine storm and toxic shock. Their polyclonal violence bypasses specific processing, which is why shock arrives faster than adaptive logic allows.
steps.say: Superantigens skip the peptide queue and activate T cells by the percent, not the clone.

right.title: Superantigen
points: Binds MHC II and TCR V beta outside groove
Activates 5 to 20 percent of T cells

steps.tx: **T cells** mature in the thymus under CD grammar: CD4 helpers reading MHC class II, CD8 cytotoxic reading class I, receptors rearranged and selected (positive and negative selection deleting self reactive), exiting to lymphoid organs where dendritic cells present antigen. CD3 is their universal badge and the target of muromonab from the pharmacology lessons.
steps.say: CD4 reads class II, CD8 reads class I, CD3 badges them all: thymic grammar in one line.

left.title: T cell subsets
points: CD8 cytotoxic: perforin and granzyme killing
Memory T: central and effector pools

right.title: Thymic education
points: Negative selection: strong self reactors deleted

steps.tx: **B cells** carry surface immunoglobulin receptors, develop in bone marrow (bursa equivalent), and on activation become plasma cells secreting antibody or memory cells awaiting recall, presenting antigen to T cells as the partnership's other half. Their developmental arrest points name the primary immunodeficiencies of the later module.
steps.say: B cells turn receptor into secretion: plasma cells are antibody factories with one specificity.

left.title: B cell journey
points: Marrow development and self tolerance checks

right.title: B cell outputs
points: Antigen presentation to helper T cells
Long lived plasma cells in marrow niches

steps.tx: **Epitopes** (determinants) are the molecular addresses antibodies and T receptors actually read: B cell epitopes often conformational surface shapes, T cell epitopes linear peptides in MHC grooves, immunodominant ones driving responses that vaccines copy and pathogens vary (antigenic variation at epitope level). Cross reactivity is epitope sharing read by one receptor.
steps.say: Immunity reads epitopes, not organisms; variation edits the address, not the building.

left.title: Epitope types
points: T cell epitopes: peptide plus MHC

right.title: Epitope consequences
points: Cross reactions between microbes and self (molecular mimicry)
Epitope masking by capsule and glycosylation

steps.tx: **Thymus dependent versus independent antigens** split B cell behaviour: protein antigens need T help (class switching, memory, germinal centres), while repetitive polysaccharides crosslink B receptors directly (TI 2) producing IgM without memory or infant response, the deficit conjugate vaccines repair by marrying polysaccharide to carrier protein (hapten carrier logic as public health).
steps.say: Pure polysaccharide cannot recruit T help or infant memory; conjugation lends both.

nodes.label: Polysaccharide alone: IgM, no memory, infant poor
T help recruited, germinal centres form

steps.tx: **Mitogens and polyclonal activators** (concanavalin A and PHA for T cells, pokeweed and LPS traditions) bypass receptors' specificity to divide lymphocytes wholesale, laboratory tools for proliferation assays and the conceptual cousins of superantigens. Adjuvants borrow a whisper of this polyclonal alarm without its storm.
steps.say: Mitogens divide lymphocytes without asking specificity; laboratories hire what toxins abuse.

left.title: Mitogen bench
points: PHA and concanavalin A: T cell division
Proliferation assays test cell mediated immunity

steps.tx: **Antigen presentation cells** rank by profession: dendritic cells (naive T activation specialists), macrophages (effector activation and innate instruction), B cells (specific antigen concentration for helpers), all displaying MHC class II to CD4 cells while every nucleated cell displays class I to CD8. The dendritic cell's migration from tissue to node is adaptive immunity's starting gun.
steps.say: Dendritic cells carry tissue news to the node and start the adaptive clock.

left.title: Professional presenters
points: Follicular dendritic: antigen display to B cells (different lineage)

right.title: Presentation rules
points: Class II exogenous pathway to CD4
Class I endogenous pathway to CD8
